caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, shaded graphite or charcoal rendering of a human head, shown in three-quarter view facing to the right. The subject's head is closely cropped, featuring short, textured hair. The facial features are pronounced, including a broad nose, full lips, and prominent cheekbones. The overall color scheme consists of various shades of gray and black set against a light-colored or beige background. The head is depicted without a body, appearing cut off at the base of the neck. title: Head (Top of Hitching Post)
